description: Use this when the user asks about events in aging research and the longevity industry: financings and deals, trial readouts, approvals, policy, conferences. One story per event, newest first, with a link to every outlet that covered it. Not for general or market news.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

q.description: Words that must all appear in the story's headline or summary (case-insensitive).

since.description: Only stories with coverage on or after this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_news
